text.en: Several pet owners praise groomers Katy and Tam for their warm, accommodating attitude, particularly when managing rescue dogs or scheduling last-minute appointments. However, other reviewers expressed strong dissatisfaction with the staff's attentiveness, citing poor execution of styling instructions and perceived oversight regarding routine physical checks.

title.en: Attractive styling mixed with grooming oversights

text.en: Many customers are delighted with their dogs' haircuts, noting soft, pleasant-smelling coats, reduced shedding, and clean ears after visits. In contrast, two reviews detail notable issues with grooming quality, including an uneven coat with patchy lengths and an overgrown dewclaw that was reportedly missed across consecutive salon sessions.

Several clients remark that their anxious or sensitive dogs were handled with patience, noting that pets came away relaxed even when receiving difficult nail trims. Conversely, one pet parent raised concerns over animal welfare when an overlooked claw embedded into a paw pad, advising fellow owners to inspect paws carefully following grooming.

q.en: What grooming services are available at Canine Clippers?

a.en: The salon provides baths, haircuts, nail trimming, dremeling, de-shedding treatments, and ear cleaning for various dog breeds.

q.en: Can the groomers handle nervous dogs or difficult nail trims?

a.en: Yes, clients frequently note that the groomers work patiently with sensitive dogs that resist paw handling, though experiences vary.

q.en: Are emergency or last-minute grooming bookings offered?

a.en: Reviewers note that the salon has accommodated urgent rescue grooms and short-notice bookings when regular groomers cancelled.

q.en: Is Canine Clippers a family-run business?

a.en: Yes, the salon operates as a family-owned dog grooming business run by a mother and daughter team in Manayunk.
